FOUNDRYMCP.ServerUrlHint: Where the Foundry MCP server is listening. Leave as ws://localhost:31415 unless you changed FOUNDRY_MCP_PORT.
FOUNDRYMCP.TokenHint: Paste the token from ~/.foundry-mcp/token on the computer running Claude (or the FOUNDRY_MCP_TOKEN you set).
FOUNDRYMCP.EnabledHint: When on, the GM's browser connects to the MCP server and lets Claude change this world.
FOUNDRYMCP.AllowScriptsHint: Let Claude run custom JavaScript in this browser (the run_script tool). Powerful; leave off unless you need it.
FOUNDRYMCP.Disconnected: Foundry MCP: connection to Claude lost. Retrying in the background.
FOUNDRYMCP.BadToken: Foundry MCP: the server rejected the token. Check the token in module settings.
